newsitem.title: GERMANY: D.Telekom preliminary prospectus next week.
newsitem.headline: D.Telekom preliminary prospectus next week.

text.p: Deutsche Telekom AG, the German telecommunications giant, said on Friday it would publish next week the preliminary prospectus containing financial details about the company ahead of its landmark November share listing.
A company spokesman said the prospectus, the so-called "Pink Herring", would be published on October 4.

The Pink Herring will contain information about the company's earnings in 1995 and the first half of 1996 and it prospects. But it will not contain the number of shares to be floated or any information about the share price.
Telekom will float shares on stock exchanges in Germany, the United States and Japan in November by means of a capital increase. It is currently fully owned by the German government.

But in order to put some of the company's capital in public hands, Bonn will decline to subscribe to the new shares created by the capital increase, making it possible to sell the shares to other investors.
This will be done by means of a book-building procedure, where Telekom lines up potential investors ahead of the listing, who then agree to buy the stock if it is sold within a certain price range.

The final prospectus, or "Red Herring", which contains the number of shares Telekom will float and the upper and lower limits of the price range, will not be published until October 22, according to Telekom sources.
That is also the date when investors in the book-building procedure can begin to subscribe to Telekom's initial public offering (IPO). The subscription period runs until November 14.
The final price of the IPO will be announced during the weekend ahead of the listing on November 18 in Europe and the United States and on November 19 in Asia.

Telekom has also set up a "Share Information Forum" (AIF) to allow private non-institutional investors to buy shares at a discount. Private investors must register with the AIF by October 11 to take advantage of the special conditions.
